name: offhours_index_levels_20261108
comment: ANCHOR: OFFHOURS_INDEX_LEVELS_20261108 — Cash-index levels off-hours for the Sunday 20:00 ET weekly-outlook
brief (LQ-20261107-939 + design WU-1). A cash index has no off-hours print, so its last regular trade is
refused by max_trade_age_minutes as a stale quote. With schwab.index_levels present, a configured $ index no
older than carry_max_age_hours is stored LEVEL ONLY in the night session the lane observes: overnight rows may
carry a level with no dated reference, validate() accepts the row unchanged, reference_basis names the basis and
the print's ET date, and the receipt carries carried_from. The carry is anchored on the session's 20:00 ET start,
so every fire of the same night conflicts on (symbol, bar_start, feed): one row per index per night.
Never widened: a stale EQUITY is still refused stale_trade, a fresh index keeps the normal settled-reference
path, and the carry is refused outside an overnight session (the Sunday futures_open window, a weekday regular
session) and past carry_max_age_hours. A configured index must come back as assetMainType INDEX; anything else
is refused by name (index_asset_type_*), never stored as if it were an index. The settle reference is the lane's
own stored Friday settle read from market_quotes_extended (the yfinance-named ES=F map is retired and refused at
config load). A bad index_levels block fails loud. Hermetic: fixture only, no network, no DB, no credential.
